purpose: Reproducibility and audit record for the EDA + feature-design investigation stage of the NPN Hackathon M5-style sales forecasting project.

source_dataset.note: This EDA is READ-ONLY against this file. It was never opened in write mode by any script in this stage.

upstream_raw_dataset.note: Not read directly by this EDA stage (all analysis derives from sales_long_full.parquet, which was itself built and validated in the earlier data-processing stage documented in processed_dataset/PROCESSING_REPORT.md).

scripts_used.name: eda_style.py
scripts_used.purpose: Shared chart color palette / matplotlib style module (dataviz-skill categorical + sequential palette).

scripts_used.name: eda_01_sanity_and_distribution.py
scripts_used.purpose: Phase 1 (structural sanity check) and Phase 2 (sales distribution).

scripts_used.name: eda_02_zero_intermittent.py
scripts_used.purpose: Phase 3 (zero-sales / intermittent demand, zero-run RLE, leading-zero vs leading-no-price alignment).

scripts_used.name: eda_03_temporal.py
scripts_used.purpose: Phase 4 (day-of-week, monthly, yearly, daily trend, week-of-year, composition-effect check).

scripts_used.name: eda_04_events_snap.py
scripts_used.purpose: Phase 5 (event effects, per-named-event lift vs local baseline) and Phase 6 (SNAP effects).

scripts_used.name: eda_05_price.py
scripts_used.purpose: Phase 7 (price distributions, price-change frequency, relative-price bins, before/after price-change sales).

scripts_used.name: eda_06_heterogeneity_correlation.py
scripts_used.purpose: Phase 8 (activity x volume segments, seasonality index, sampled event/price sensitivity) and Phase 9 (lag/rolling/price/snap/event correlations, days-since-last-sale bucket analysis).

scripts_used.name: eda_07_feature_table.py
scripts_used.purpose: Phase 10-11 (candidate feature table with leakage assessment column), written via csv.DictWriter for correct quoting.

output_files.tables: EDA/tables/*.csv (33 CSV tables, listed in EDA_REPORT.md)
output_files.statistics: EDA/statistics/*.json (8 phase-level JSON stat dumps, this file, plus this audit file itself)

sampling_methods_used.location: Phase 8c - per-series event sensitivity and price-sales correlation
sampling_methods_used.method: Stratified random sample, seed=99, n=501 series out of 30,490, proportionally allocated across cat_id x volume_tier strata (numpy.random.default_rng(99)).
sampling_methods_used.reason: Computing exact per-series event/price correlations for all 30,490 series individually was unnecessary for an exploratory distribution-of-effects view; a stratified sample gives a representative picture at a fraction of the cost.

full_data_analyses: All of Phase 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 run on the complete 59,181,090-row table.
Phase 8's activity x volume segmentation and seasonality index run on all 30,490 series.
Phase 9's lag/rolling correlations, price/snap/event point correlations, and days-since-last-sale bucket analysis all run on the complete 59,181,090-row table.

important_parameters.activity_class_thresholds: Data-driven: p25/p75/p95 of the per-series zero-sales-percentage distribution (computed in Phase 3, reused identically in Phase 8). Not arbitrary round numbers.
important_parameters.zero_run_definition: A maximal consecutive run of sales==0 rows within a single id, computed after explicitly sorting by (id, date) - required because the Parquet file's physical row order is date-major (an artifact of the original wide-to-long melt), not id-major.
important_parameters.leading_zero_window: Days from each series' common start date (2011-01-29) to its first sales>0 row.
important_parameters.event_lift_baseline: For each named-event occurrence date, the local baseline is the mean of same-weekday, non-event dates within +/-21 days (falls back to all same-weekday non-event dates if that window is empty).
important_parameters.relative_price_bins: [<0.85x, 0.85-0.95x, 0.95-1.0x, 1.0-1.05x, 1.05-1.15x, >1.15x] of each series' own mean observed price.
important_parameters.price_change_before_after_window: 7-day trailing mean (days t-7..t-1) vs 7-day leading mean (days t+1..t+7) around each detected price-change event, per id, both requiring >=3 valid days.
important_parameters.lag_definitions: lag_1/7/14/28 computed via groupby('id').shift(k) after sorting by (id, date); Pearson correlation against same-day sales computed only over rows where the lag is defined (no group-boundary leakage).

validation_checks_performed_during_this_: Row/column shape of sales_long_full.parquet confirmed unchanged before and after this EDA stage (checksum comparison, see Final Validation).
All zero-sales counts, sums, and percentiles recomputed fresh from the loaded DataFrame in each phase script rather than reused from prior stages, to catch any accidental mutation.
Sorting for time-order-dependent computations (zero-run RLE, lag/rolling features, price-change windows) explicitly verified against the known date-major storage order rather than assumed.
feature_candidates.csv round-tripped through pandas.read_csv after generation to confirm well-formed quoting (27 rows x 8 columns).
explicit_non_actions: No values in sales_long_full.parquet were read via any method other than pandas.read_parquet (read-only).
raw_dataset/ was not opened by any script in this stage.

No model was trained. No forecasting algorithm was selected. No hyperparameters were tuned. No 28-day forecast was produced. No final ML training dataset (with engineered features) was created. No project novelty was decided.
